messages.author: 9452522e9ba0f859
messages.subject: age definition variables in linear growth model (individually-varying times of observation)
parts: Hello, does lavaan have the option to set age as the time metric in a linear growth model, as individually-varying times of observation? These would age definition variables, where the slope factor loadings are fixed to each person's age at a given wave. An old post said this was not possible, wondering if it is now. Thanks!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: age definition variables in linear growth model (individually-varying times of observation)
parts: does lavaan have the option to set age as the time metric in a linear growth model, as individually-varying times of observation?

No, but OpenMx does (and Mplus via the TSCORES option).  If you are comfortable with Bayesian / MCMC estimation and a little programming effort, then you can specify a regular (fixed-loadings) growth model in the blavaan, save the JAGS or Stan syntax, and edit it to change the loadings from values to variables that are in your data.
